events.title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful
must_haves: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.

withheld: It should feel quiet and a little hopeful.
You can pick the scene or subject.
You can pick the illustration style.
You can pick the size or where it will be used.

events.text:
The request is open-ended, with no subject given, so I could either ask what they have in mind or pick a sensible subject and generate something. Since asking costs little, I lean toward making a pleasant illustration with a reasonable creative choice and offering to adjust it afterward. I also need to check that the default model isn't a paid one, since the system says this is a free plan.

I'm weighing whether to use the default model or a specific free one, since the default might not be free-eligible on this plan. I'll go with z-image-turbo at 640px using the ai-illustration-generator style, since that's a safe free choice and the user didn't ask for anything else.
